knowledge_state.basis: All 10 records use the portal seed defaults at the fixed baseline instant; no per-case corpus filtering.

split_policy.method: manual business-subproblem groups, fixed before scoring

refund-submission.intent: 退款申请入口和处理责任

client-protocol.intent: Claude Code 接入时协议与模型的匹配

invoice-correction.intent: 发票抬头修改的处理权限

historical-status.intent: 历史故障公告与当前状态的证据边界

dynamic-request-duration.intent: 只查询某次请求的耗时

split_policy.same_knowledge_id_across_splits: allowed; the same article can support distinct business subproblems
split_policy.holdout_use: Reserve for final validation after fixing retrieval settings on development. Both files are distributed; this is not third-party blind evaluation.

labeling.author: ChatGPT-assisted
labeling.method: Read all 10 frozen knowledge entries and annotate supporting evidence before running retrieval; do not label from retrieved rankings.
labeling.query_unit: The complete query string is retrieval input. No rewrite, dialogue memory, answer generation or tool execution is evaluated.
labeling.source: New synthetic questions based on the demo business rules; no original customer export or account credentials.
labeling.quality_claim: Proposed labels, not independently human-verified gold labels.
